stories.title: BBC analysis of leaked Rosstat data shows at least 490,334 Russian soldiers killed since 2022
stories.summary: BBC analysts examined more than 11 million Russian death records from 2021 to September 2026 that were leaked after a cyber‑attack attributed to the Belarusian group Cyber Partisans BY and Ukraine’s Silent Crow. The data indicate that at least 490,334 Russian military personnel have died since the invasion began in 2022. The Kremlin reiterated that only the defence ministry can officially report casualty figures, which it has not released for several years.
stories.why: The figure provides an independent estimate of Russian military losses, challenging the official silence and informing public understanding of the war’s human cost.

stories.title: India allocates 8,606 tonnes of raw cane sugar for US export under TRQ
stories.summary: India has set aside 8,606 metric tonnes of raw cane sugar for shipment to the United States under the existing Tariff Rate Quota (TRQ) arrangement. The allocation is part of the bilateral mechanism that limits the volume of sugar entering the US at reduced tariff rates. The shipment will be made available to Indian exporters seeking access to the US market.
